final: WITH c AS (SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p.bats),''),'') AS hand, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM player_award a JOIN player p ON p.player_id=a.player_id GROUP BY 1), s AS (SELECT hand, cnt, cnt*1.0/(SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM c) AS share FROM c) SELECT hand AS bats, cnt AS award_count, share, share-(SELECT AVG(share) FROM s) AS above_average FROM s WHERE share>(SELECT AVG(share) FROM s)
